title: Variables
description: Declare variables, define a constant, and define your first enum.

checkpoints.title: Local variables
checkpoints.description: main() declares and prints an int, double, boolean, and String local variable.

checkpoints.title: Team name constant
checkpoints.description: A public static final TEAM_NAME constant equal to "Team 4143" (team standard: SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE).

checkpoints.title: Alliance enum
checkpoints.description: An Alliance enum with RED and BLUE values (team standard: UpperCamelCase type name, SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE values).

checkpoints.title: Match period enum
checkpoints.description: A MatchPeriod enum with AUTONOMOUS, TELEOP, and ENDGAME values (team standard: UpperCamelCase type name, SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE values).

checkpoints.title: Max speed constant
checkpoints.description: A public static final MAX_SPEED constant equal to 5.0 (team standard: SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE).
